headline: Executive order aims to promote equal pay and clearer pay information for people who work for federal contractors.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on pay fairness and openness about pay in federal contracting. Based on its title, it uses the government's power as a buyer of goods and services to push for equal pay and more transparency about wages. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may face new pay-related rules or expectations as a condition of doing business with the government.

who_it_affects.group: Workers and job applicants at federal contractors
who_it_affects.how: They are the people whose pay and hiring the order is meant to make fairer and more transparent.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 15, 2022; any specific rules it calls for would likely come later.
